dialogues.speaker: Mansa
dialogues.text: Hello, and welcome to the Natlan branch of the Adventurers' Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Mansa
dialogues.text: Nice to meet you, I'm the local Branch Master.

dialogues.speaker: Mansa
dialogues.text: If you're new to Natlan, I recommend that you find yourself a local guide or someone who knows the lay of the land before setting out.

dialogues.speaker: Mansa
dialogues.text: I wish you the best of luck.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could I just look for you?

dialogues.speaker: Mansa
dialogues.text: In theory, of course. But most of the time I have to stay here to help adventurers who come for advice.

dialogues.speaker: Mansa
dialogues.text: There's no doubt that Ms. Katheryne is extremely reliable, but when it comes to all things Natlan, no one's more knowledgeable than us natives.

dialogues.speaker: Mansa
dialogues.text: And in terms of their abilities, the Scions of the Canopy or the People of the Springs would make even better tour guides than I would.

dialogues.speaker: Mansa
dialogues.text: As for me... Well, if you'd like, I can tell your fortune before you set off, I suppose?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have any commissions for me?

dialogues.speaker: Mansa
dialogues.text: There are always people who need help, all the more so after a war.

dialogues.speaker: Mansa
dialogues.text: But thanks to all the help we received from Katheryne and the adventurers, we now have a lot less on our plate.

dialogues.speaker: Mansa
dialogues.text: I even heard that some Fatui soldiers helped out with some of the work, which is almost unheard of. Very unusual indeed.
